Definition: from G4496; a jerk (of the eye, i.e. (by analogy) an instant):--twinkling.
BiblicalUsage: In a moment, in the twinkling of an eye, at the last trump, for the trumpet shall sound, and the dead shall be raised incorruptible, and we shall be changed.
TheologicalSignificance: My position is that the twinkling is the shortest time God needs, and the change will not take longer.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
